---
name: Bug report / Hlášení chyby
about: Report reproducible behavior without exposing raw device contents
labels: bug
---

## Version / Verze

FlashBridge version, Python, ImDisk, Windows build:

## Mode / Režim

- [ ] Discovery only / detekce
- [ ] Read-only mount
- [ ] Experimental read-write mount
- [ ] Copy missing files
- [ ] Safe unmount

## Expected vs observed / Očekáváno a skutečnost

Describe steps and result. **Do not paste private filenames or unredacted logs.**

## Evidence / Důkazy

Paste anonymized error codes and offsets only. Remove usernames, mount source paths, device serial numbers, card fingerprints, music names and other private content.

## Hardware (optional)

Reader model, media type, connection details. No raw disk dumps.
